answer.note: NVIDIA says it is introducing a model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure with revenue sharing and credit support; NVIDIA says it expects standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity, creating a potential usage-linked earnings stream (incoming). This is evidence of NVIDIA’s stated commercial approach, not evidence here of signed arrangements, realized revenue, or the size or timing of any contribution. NVIDIA also says AI cloud companies are building DSX AI factories (item:e3). It reports that Firmus is building a Batam campus expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs (item:e4), a potential infrastructure-supply and capacity lead, not a disclosed NVIDIA order or proof that this campus uses the new commercial model. Sharon AI’s CEO described a strategic collaboration with NVIDIA, but the quote does not specify commercial terms or tie it explicitly to the model (item:e2). NVIDIA identifies demand from AI-native companies and their customers for training and inference capacity, but provides no quantified demand or customer commitments (incoming). If these arrangements are implemented and supported capacity is utilized, the model could extend NVIDIA’s sales opportunity and add revenue linked to cloud usage; the source does not establish the scale or financial impact.
limitations: The article does not identify which named AI clouds, if any, have signed agreements under the revenue-sharing and credit-support model; signing status is not established.
Revenue-share terms, credit-support structure and risk allocation, supported capacity, deployment timing, utilization, and resulting revenue are not disclosed.
Firmus’s stated 360 MW and up to 170,000-GPU scale is an expected campus capacity, not a disclosed NVIDIA purchase quantity, delivery schedule, or confirmed deployment under the model.
The article gives no quantified customer commitments or demand, so it does not establish how much of the announced or planned capacity will be utilized.
follow_up: Check subsequent NVIDIA filings and company disclosures for signed AI-cloud arrangements under this model, identified counterparties, credit-support obligations, and revenue-share terms.
Check Firmus and Sharon AI disclosures for campus deployment schedules, NVIDIA equipment commitments, and whether their projects use the announced model.
Track NVIDIA financial disclosures for revenue attributable to supported capacity and any stated utilization or customer-demand measures.
